title: Canonical component functor, projection, and scalar compatibility
statement: For an affine scheme T [def-pc-scheme], let P be its profinite component quotient [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. Extract F_T:Profinite/P→T_proet, its continuous coordinates, continuity, and its set-sheaf geometric morphism from the geometrically characterized construction [lem-zl-affine-component-site-projection]. The characterization is |T|×_P E with the inverse-image structure sheaf, so the choices are determined up to the isomorphisms used downstream. Let ring pushforward be restriction along exactly F_T. For sites J,K, ring sheaves A,B and objects c,d, a ring isomorphism e:A(c)≅B(d), and an equivalence ED of their unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define scalar compatibility to mean: every left derived extension from discrete R-modules commutes with ED under the global ring identification e; for commutative R this also holds in the sheafified constant-ring presentation [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor], for scalar maps agreeing on all constant global sections. The predicate quantifies over arbitrary additive left adjoints and arbitrary localization counits and keeps their independent derived-category universes. For an additive equivalence E:Mod(A)≌Mod(B) of module sheaves, define constant-ring compatibility: for every commutative discrete R there is an additive equivalence ER of the constant-R module-sheaf categories preserving constant realization [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor], such that any scalar-extension left adjoints FS,FV along ring maps from the constant rings to A and B agreeing on constant global sections under e satisfy FS⋙E≅ER⋙FV. Define ordinary scalar compatibility as constant-ring compatibility together with FS⋙E≅FV for all left adjoints FS,FV to evaluation at c and d followed by scalar restriction along a:R→A(c) and e∘a, for every discrete ring R.
